title: Keep vault copies another writer changed when a refused trim rolls back (110)
description: Keep vault copies another writer changed when a refused trim rolls back (110)
no_spec_change_rationale: Bug fix within REQ-cli-046 and KNOW-10: a restore must not delete another writer's bytes; no requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: A refused trim apply removes only the vault copies it created that still hold the bytes and mode it wrote; a copy another writer changed is kept as written and named in the refusal; the source is restored either way. The new test fails first and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Issue #110 (P1); Leif: release 0.4.0 after #112, #114 and #110 (2026-11-05 09:43 MST, via the orc).
